name: Compliance Posture Assessment
description: Continuously assesses the agent's compliance posture against active regulatory overlays. Generates posture scores, identifies compliance gaps, and tracks remediation progress for each applicable framework.
threat_addressed: Compliance posture degrades silently without continuous assessment. Point-in-time audits miss drift between assessments. Organizations discover compliance gaps during external audits rather than proactively, leading to costly remediation under time pressure.
enforcement_mechanism: Evaluates current control state against requirements from active overlays. Calculates per-framework compliance scores based on control pass rates, evidence completeness, and configuration alignment. Generates posture reports on demand.

security_outcome.pass: Compliance posture assessed — meeting requirements for active overlays.
security_outcome.fail: Compliance gaps identified in one or more active overlay requirements.

display_detail: Assesses compliance posture against active regulatory overlays and identifies gaps.
remediation_hint_template: Compliance gaps detected. Review the posture report and address identified gaps for each active overlay.
